blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Tom is timid, but Mary isn't.
exercises.ru: Том робкий, ___ Мэри — нет.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Boston is too cold for me, let alone Chicago.
exercises.ru: Бостон для меня слишком холодный, ___ Чикаго и подавно.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: My father does play golf, but not well.
exercises.ru: Мой отец играет в гольф, ___ неважнецки.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: That's not a cricket, that's a grasshopper.
exercises.ru: Это не сверчок, ___ кузнечик.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Not only you but also I was involved.
exercises.ru: Не только ты, ___ и я был втянут.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: A promise made is a debt unpaid.
exercises.ru: Давши слово, держись, ___ не давши, крепись.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The stories that circulated about the old graveyard were contradictory, but nevertheless made your heart freeze.
exercises.ru: О старом кладбище ходили противоречивые, ___ неизменно леденящие душу рассказы.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He said he wanted to go, but didn't say the reason clearly.
exercises.ru: Он сказал, что хочет идти, ___ не сказал внятно почему.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Reading is equivalent to thinking with someone else's head instead of with one's own.
exercises.ru: Чтение эквивалентно мышлению при помощи чужой головы, ___ не своей собственной.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Do capybaras get along with dogs?
exercises.ru: ___ капибары ладят с собаками?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: She's not my daughter. She's my stepdaughter.
exercises.ru: Она мне не дочь, ___ падчерица.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: It's bad weather, to be sure, but we've seen worse.
exercises.ru: Да уж, погодка сегодня мерзкая, ___ бывало и похуже.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Markdown is a markup language, but a very readable one.
exercises.ru: Markdown  —  это язык разметки, ___ легкочитаемый.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The British troops fought bravely, but were unable to stop the Germans.
exercises.ru: Британские войска отважно сражались, ___ не сумели остановить немцев.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Both of his parents are German; his dad is Bavarian and his Mum is Swabish.
exercises.ru: Оба родителя у него немцы: отец баварец, ___ мать — швабка.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Warts are ugly but harmless.
exercises.ru: Бородавки некрасивы, ___ безопасны.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Technically hiragana is a syllabary, not an alphabet.
exercises.ru: Строго говоря, хирагана — это силлабарий, ___ не алфавит.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Concentrate, but don't strain yourself.
exercises.ru: Сосредоточься, ___ не сильно напрягайся.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Your temper is quick, but the way you speak is terrible.
exercises.ru: Темперамент есть, ___ говор ужасный.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Her technique is superb, but she needs to play with more expression.
exercises.ru: Техника у неё великолепная, ___ ей нужно играть более выразительно.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
